CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION design.ack_outbox(event_id uuid, token uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
 WITH changed AS (UPDATE design.outbox SET published_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_until=NULL
 WHERE id=event_id AND claim_token=token AND published_at IS NULL RETURNING 1)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION design.append_only()

AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION design.claim_outbox(batch_limit integer, token uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF outbox
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
 WITH due AS (
  SELECT id FROM design.outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND available_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY available_at,id
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT greatest(1,least(batch_limit,100))
 ) UPDATE design.outbox o SET claim_token=token,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',publish_attempts=publish_attempts+1
 FROM due WHERE o.id=due.id RETURNING o.*;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION design.renew_outbox(event_id uuid, token uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
 WITH changed AS (UPDATE design.outbox SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds'
 WHERE id=event_id AND claim_token=token AND published_at IS NULL RETURNING 1)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION design.renew_step(op uuid, key text, input sha256, expected_fence bigint, owner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
 WITH changed AS (UPDATE design.step_receipts s SET heartbeat_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds'
 WHERE operation_id=op AND step_key=key AND input_digest=input AND fence=expected_fence AND owner_token=owner AND state='running'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM design.operations o WHERE o.id=op AND o.state='running') RETURNING 1)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION retrieval.eligible_chunks(allowed_sources uuid[], as_of timestamp with time zone, excluded_groups uuid[], formal_score boolean)
 RETURNS SETOF retrieval.chunks
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'retrieval', 'design', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT c.* FROM chunks c
 WHERE c.source_id=ANY(allowed_sources)
 AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM source_ancestors a JOIN source_nodes n ON n.id=a.ancestor_id
  LEFT JOIN source_heads h ON h.source_id=n.id
  WHERE a.source_id=c.source_id AND (
   n.known_at>as_of OR h.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'published' OR h.valid_from>as_of OR (h.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND h.valid_until<=as_of)
   OR (formal_score AND n.policy_class<>'prebid_content')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_group_memberships g WHERE g.source_id=n.id AND g.group_id=ANY(excluded_groups))
  )
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION retrieval.formal_score_context(target_review uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF retrieval.chunks
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'retrieval', 'design', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT c.id,c.source_id,c.parse_id,c.physical_page,c.ordinal,c.chapter_path,c.evidence_ids,c.text_content,c.lexemes,c.lex_tsv,c.token_count,c.digest
 FROM retrieval.score_context_chunks c WHERE c.review_id=target_review;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION retrieval.no_lineage_cycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'retrieval', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(90127,1);
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS (SELECT NEW.parent_id UNION SELECT e.parent_id FROM lineage_edges e JOIN ancestors a ON e.child_id=a.id) SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE id=NEW.child_id) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'lineage_cycle' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
